TEST FIXTURE - NOT AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT
Academic Regulations for B.Tech Programmes (Fixture)
Issued by the Office of the Dean (Academics). Version 3.1, effective 1 July 2024.

1. Short Title and Applicability
These regulations apply to all students admitted to the B.Tech programmes of the University.

2. Definitions
2.1 "Course" means a unit of study with a course code and credits.
2.2 "Active backlog" means a course that a student has failed or been absent in and has not yet cleared.
2.3 "Detained" means a student who is not permitted to appear in the end-semester examination of a course.
\f
7. Attendance
7.1 Attendance is computed separately for each course as classes attended divided by classes held, expressed as a percentage.
7.2 A student must have a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to appear in the end-semester examination of that course.
7.3 Subject to clause 7.2, the Dean (Academics) may condone a shortage of up to 10% on documented medical grounds. No condonation is permitted beyond this limit.
7.4 A student who does not satisfy clause 7.2 (after any condonation under clause 7.3) shall be detained in that course and must re-register for it.
\f
8. Examinations and Passing
8.1 Each course carries 100 marks: 40 marks for internal assessment and 60 marks for the end-semester examination.
8.2 To pass a course, a student must obtain a minimum of 40% of the total marks in that course.
8.3 Grading table:
Marks 90-100 Grade O (10 points); 80-89 A+ (9); 70-79 A (8); 60-69 B+ (7); 50-59 B (6); 40-49 C (5); below 40 F (0).
9. Supplementary Examinations
9.1 A student who has failed in a course, or was absent in its end-semester examination, is eligible to appear in the supplementary examination of that course. A detained student is not eligible to appear in the supplementary examination.
9.2 Procedure: The student shall apply through the ERP portal within 7 days of the declaration of results, pay the supplementary examination fee of Rs 1000 per course, and collect the admit card from the Examination Branch.
9.3 Internal assessment marks are carried forward to the supplementary examination.
